100	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
101	# Side-effect classification helpers
102	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
103	
104	_SIDE_EFFECT_ORDER = ["READ_ONLY", "LOCAL_WRITE", "REMOTE_WRITE", "SUBMISSION"]
105	
106	# Hard-deny patterns for run_bash (regardless of policy).
107	_HARD_DENY_PATTERNS = [
108	    "sudo *",
109	    "rm -rf*",
110	    "git push*",
111	    "kaggle submit*",
112	]
113	_HARD_DENY_SUBSTRINGS = [".."]
114	
115	
116	def _side_effect_ge(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
117	    """Return True if side-effect a >= b in severity."""
118	    try:
119	        return _SIDE_EFFECT_ORDER.index(a) >= _SIDE_EFFECT_ORDER.index(b)
120	    except ValueError:
121	        return False
122	
123	
124	def _bash_side_effect(command: str) -> str:
125	    """Classify the side-effect level of a bash command."""
126	    cmd = command.strip()
127	    if any(
128	        fnmatch.fnmatch(cmd, pat)
129	        for pat in ["kca kaggle submit*", "kca kaggle push*", "kca kaggle upload*"]
130	    ):
131	        return "SUBMISSION"
132	    if any(
133	        fnmatch.fnmatch(cmd, pat)
134	        for pat in ["kca kaggle *", "kca run *", "python *", "pytest *"]
135	    ):
136	        return "LOCAL_WRITE"
137	    return "LOCAL_WRITE"
138	
139	
140	def _is_bash_allowed(command: str, policy: JobPolicy) -> tuple[bool, str]:
141	    """Return (allowed, reason). Hard-deny takes priority over policy."""
142	    cmd = command.strip()
143	    for sub in _HARD_DENY_SUBSTRINGS:
144	        if sub in cmd:
145	            return False, "command not in allowed_tool_patterns"
146	    for pat in _HARD_DENY_PATTERNS:
147	        if fnmatch.fnmatch(cmd, pat):
148	            return False, "command not in allowed_tool_patterns"
149	    for pat in policy.allowed_tool_patterns:
150	        if fnmatch.fnmatch(cmd, pat):
151	            return True, ""
152	    return False, "command not in allowed_tool_patterns"
153	
154	
155	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
156	# ApprovalRequired exception
157	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
158	
159	
160	class ApprovalRequired(Exception):
161	    """Raised when a tool call exceeds policy.max_side_effect."""
162	
163	    def __init__(self, tool_name: str, tool_input: dict, side_effect: str):
164	        self.tool_name = tool_name
165	        self.tool_input = tool_input
166	        self.side_effect = side_effect
167	        super().__init__(f"{tool_name} requires approval (side_effect={side_effect})")
168	
169	
170	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
171	# ToolExecutor
172	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
173	
174	
175	class ToolExecutor:
176	    def __init__(self, workspace: Path, policy: JobPolicy):
177	        self.workspace = workspace.resolve()
178	        self.policy = policy
179	
180	    def _guard_path(self, path: str) -> tuple[Path | None, str | None]:
181	        """Resolve path within workspace. Return (resolved, None) or (None, error)."""
182	        target = (self.workspace / path).resolve()
183	        if not str(target).startswith(str(self.workspace)):
184	            return None, f"path traversal rejected: {path}"
185	        return target, None
186	
187	    def execute(self, tool_name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
188	        # Determine side effect and check approval gate.
189	        se = self._classify_side_effect(tool_name, tool_input)
190	        if (
191	            _side_effect_ge(se, self.policy.max_side_effect)
192	            and se != self.policy.max_side_effect
193	        ):
194	            raise ApprovalRequired(tool_name, tool_input, se)
195	
196	        if tool_name == "read_file":
197	            return self._read_file(tool_input)
198	        elif tool_name == "write_file":
199	            return self._write_file(tool_input)
200	        elif tool_name == "edit_file":
201	            return self._edit_file(tool_input)
202	        elif tool_name == "run_bash":
203	            return self._run_bash(tool_input)
204	        elif tool_name == "grep_workspace":
205	            return self._grep_workspace(tool_input)
206	        else:
207	            return f"unknown tool: {tool_name}"
208	
209	    def _classify_side_effect(self, tool_name: str, tool_input: dict) -> str:
210	        if tool_name in ("read_file", "grep_workspace"):
211	            return "READ_ONLY"
212	        if tool_name in ("write_file", "edit_file"):
213	            return "LOCAL_WRITE"
214	        if tool_name == "run_bash":
215	            return _bash_side_effect(tool_input.get("command", ""))
216	        return "LOCAL_WRITE"
217	
218	    def _read_file(self, inp: dict) -> str:
219	        target, err = self._guard_path(inp["path"])
220	        if err:
221	            return err
222	        try:
223	            return target.read_text(errors="replace")
224	        except Exception as e:
225	            return f"read_file error: {e}"
226	
227	    def _write_file(self, inp: dict) -> str:
228	        target, err = self._guard_path(inp["path"])
229	        if err:
230	            return err
231	        try:
232	            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
233	            target.write_text(inp["content"])
234	            return "ok"
235	        except Exception as e:
236	            return f"write_file error: {e}"
237	
238	    def _edit_file(self, inp: dict) -> str:
239	        target, err = self._guard_path(inp["path"])
240	        if err:
241	            return err
242	        try:
243	            text = target.read_text(errors="replace")
244	            old = inp["old_string"]
245	            new = inp["new_string"]
246	            if old not in text:
247	                return f"edit_file error: old_string not found in {inp['path']}"
248	            target.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
249	            return "ok"
250	        except Exception as e:
251	            return f"edit_file error: {e}"
252	
253	    def _run_bash(self, inp: dict) -> str:
254	        command = inp.get("command", "")
255	        timeout_s = int(inp.get("timeout_s", 60))
256	        allowed, reason = _is_bash_allowed(command, self.policy)
257	        if not allowed:
258	            return json.dumps({"stdout": "", "stderr": reason, "exit_code": 126})
259	        try:
260	            proc = subprocess.run(
261	                command,
262	                shell=True,
263	                capture_output=True,
264	                text=True,
265	                timeout=timeout_s,
266	                cwd=str(self.workspace),
267	            )
268	            return json.dumps(
269	                {
270	                    "stdout": proc.stdout,
271	                    "stderr": proc.stderr,
272	                    "exit_code": proc.returncode,
273	                }
274	            )
275	        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
276	            return json.dumps({"stdout": "", "stderr": "timeout", "exit_code": 124})
277	        except Exception as e:
278	            return json.dumps({"stdout": "", "stderr": str(e), "exit_code": 1})
279	
280	    def _grep_workspace(self, inp: dict) -> str:
281	        pattern = inp.get("pattern", "")
282	        search_path = inp.get("path", ".")
283	        target, err = self._guard_path(search_path)
284	        if err:
285	            return err
286	        results = []
287	        try:
288	            for p in sorted(target.rglob("*")):
289	                if not p.is_file():
290	                    continue
291	                try:
292	                    for i, line in enumerate(
293	                        p.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines(), 1
294	                    ):
295	                        if pattern.lower() in line.lower():
296	                            results.append(
297	                                {
298	                                    "file": str(p.relative_to(self.workspace)),
299	                                    "line_number": i,
300	                                    "line": line,
301	                                }
302	                            )
303	                except Exception:
304	                    continue
305	        except Exception as e:
306	            return f"grep_workspace error: {e}"
307	        return json.dumps(results)
308

+        """M8 tool dispatch with ToolSpec + JobPolicy enforcement.

+        Resolution order:

+             "ask" → ApprovalRequired (pauses job, records human_decisions);
+             "allow" or unset → fall through.

+             subprocess-shaped tools; in-process tools observe it via a best

+        else:
+            timeout = None
+
+        if timeout and timeout > 0:

+        # ``unsandboxed`` requires explicit "allow" — already gated above; this
+        # is a belt-and-braces check.
+        if sandbox == "unsandboxed":

+                raise PolicyViolation(spec.name, decision="unsandboxed_needs_allow")

mocked LiteLLM client so no real network or model calls happen, and asserts
the matching audit JSONL line plus the worker's stop_reason.

import json
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))

from src.worker._types import JobPolicy  # noqa: E402
from src.worker.worker import AgentWorker, MockLiteLLMClient  # noqa: E402


def _single_call_client(tool_name: str, tool_input: dict) -> MockLiteLLMClient:
    """LiteLLM mock that emits one tool call then stops."""

    client = MockLiteLLMClient(scenario="two_turns")
    turn = {"n": 0}

    def completion(**_kwargs):
        turn["n"] += 1
        if turn["n"] == 1:
            tc = types.SimpleNamespace(
                id="call_x",
                type="function",
                function=types.SimpleNamespace(
                    name=tool_name,
                    arguments=json.dumps(tool_input),
                ),
            )
            msg = types.SimpleNamespace(content=None, tool_calls=[tc])
            choice = types.SimpleNamespace(message=msg, finish_reason="tool_calls")
            return types.SimpleNamespace(
                choices=[choice],
                usage=types.SimpleNamespace(prompt_tokens=20, completion_tokens=10),
            )
        msg = types.SimpleNamespace(content="done", tool_calls=None)
        choice = types.SimpleNamespace(message=msg, finish_reason="stop")
        return types.SimpleNamespace(
            choices=[choice],
            usage=types.SimpleNamespace(prompt_tokens=10, completion_tokens=5),
        )

    client.completion = completion  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    return client


def _build_worker(
    tmp_path: Path,
    tool_decisions: dict,
    audit_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> AgentWorker:
    """Construct a worker with the audit path redirected into the test dir."""
    # Redirect the audit file to the per-test path so tests are isolated.
    monkeypatch.setenv("KCA_SESSION_ID", "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111")

    # Patch the AuditLogger's default file_path resolver to use the per-test path.
    from tools.kca.agent import audit as audit_mod

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        audit_mod, "_default_audit_path", lambda: audit_path, raising=True
    )

    policy = JobPolicy(
        skill_name="_test_fixture",
        policy_profile="permissive-dev",
        mode="default",
        tool_decisions=tool_decisions,
    )
    (tmp_path / "hello.txt").write_text("hello world", encoding="utf-8")
    worker = AgentWorker(
        job_id="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
        prompt="read the file",
        policy=policy,
        workspace=tmp_path,
        db_url=None,
        dry_run=True,
    )
    worker._mock_client = _single_call_client("read_file", {"path": "hello.txt"})
    return worker


def _audit_lines(audit_path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    if not audit_path.is_file():
        return []
    return [json.loads(line) for line in audit_path.read_text().splitlines() if line]


def test_worker_tool_call_allow_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    audit = tmp_path / "audit.jsonl"
    worker = _build_worker(
        tmp_path,
        tool_decisions={"read_file": "allow"},
        audit_path=audit,
        monkeypatch=monkeypatch,
    )
    result = worker.run()
    assert result.status == "done", result
    assert result.stop_reason == "end_turn"
    rows = _audit_lines(audit)
    allow_rows = [r for r in rows if r["tool_name"] == "read_file"]
    assert allow_rows, "expected at least one read_file audit row"
    assert allow_rows[-1]["decision"] == "allow"


def test_worker_tool_call_ask_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    audit = tmp_path / "audit.jsonl"
    worker = _build_worker(
        tmp_path,
        tool_decisions={"read_file": "ask"},
        audit_path=audit,
        monkeypatch=monkeypatch,
    )
    result = worker.run()
    assert result.status == "paused", result
    assert result.stop_reason == "approval_required"
    rows = _audit_lines(audit)
    ask_rows = [r for r in rows if r["decision"] == "ask"]
    assert ask_rows, "expected an audit row with decision=ask"
    # File should not have been mutated, and the worker should never have hit
    # the "tool_result" path. (Tool ran but produced no side effect for read.)


def test_worker_tool_call_deny_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    audit = tmp_path / "audit.jsonl"
    worker = _build_worker(
        tmp_path,
        tool_decisions={"read_file": "deny"},
        audit_path=audit,
        monkeypatch=monkeypatch,
    )
    result = worker.run()
    assert result.status == "failed", result
    assert result.stop_reason == "policy_violation"
    rows = _audit_lines(audit)
    deny_rows = [r for r in rows if r["decision"] == "deny"]
    assert deny_rows, "expected an audit row with decision=deny"

/**

 * Read-only by design. Every mutation in M8 flows through
 * `services/decision_api/` so the M7 permission policy stays authoritative.

 * `supabase gen types` is a future M9+ optimisation.
 */

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Read functions
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

async function rows<T>(query: any): Promise<T[]> {
  const { data, error } = await query;
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data as T[] | null) ?? [];
}

async function maybeOne<T>(query: any): Promise<T | null> {
  const { data, error } = await query.maybeSingle();
  if (error) throw error;
  return (data as T) ?? null;
}

export const db = {
  // Projects
  listProjects(limit = 50): Promise<Project[]> {
    return rows<Project>(
      supabase
        .from("projects")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(limit),
    );
  },
  getProject(id: Uuid): Promise<Project | null> {
    return maybeOne<Project>(supabase.from("projects").select("*").eq("id", id));
  },

  // Competitions
  listCompetitions(limit = 50): Promise<Competition[]> {
    return rows<Competition>(
      supabase
        .from("competitions")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(limit),
    );
  },

  // Runs / jobs
  listRecentRuns(limit = 20): Promise<AgentJob[]> {
    return rows<AgentJob>(
      supabase
        .from("agent_jobs")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(limit),
    );
  },
  listInflightJobs(): Promise<AgentJob[]> {
    return rows<AgentJob>(
      supabase
        .from("agent_jobs")
        .select("*")
        .in("status", ["queued", "running", "paused"])
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false }),
    );

    competitionId: Uuid,
    limit = 50,
  ): Promise<Run[]> {

        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(limit),
    );

  getJob(id: Uuid): Promise<AgentJob | null> {
    return maybeOne<AgentJob>(supabase.from("agent_jobs").select("*").eq("id", id));
  },

        .from("human_decisions")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(limit),
    );
  },
  getDecision(id: Uuid): Promise<HumanDecision | null> {
    return maybeOne<HumanDecision>(
      supabase.from("human_decisions").select("*").eq("id", id),
    );
  },
  listReviewsForJob(jobId: Uuid): Promise<AgentReview[]> {
    return rows<AgentReview>(
      supabase
        .from("agent_reviews")
        .select("*")
        .eq("job_id", jobId)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false }),
    );
  },

  // Artifacts
  listArtifacts(limit = 100): Promise<Artifact[]> {
    return rows<Artifact>(
      supabase
        .from("artifacts")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(limit),
    );
  },
  getArtifact(id: Uuid): Promise<Artifact | null> {
    return maybeOne<Artifact>(supabase.from("artifacts").select("*").eq("id", id));
  },

  // Tool audit
  listToolAudit(jobId?: Uuid, limit = 50): Promise<AgentToolAudit[]> {
    let q = supabase
      .from("agent_tool_audit")
      .select("*")
      .order("ts", { ascending: false })
      .limit(limit);
    if (jobId) q = q.eq("job_id", jobId);
    return rows<AgentToolAudit>(q);
  },
};

```

```typescript
import { Component, type ReactNode } from "react";

interface State {
  error: Error | null;
}

const isDev = import.meta.env.DEV;

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<{ children: ReactNode }, State> {
  state: State = { error: null };

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error): void {
    console.error("[ErrorBoundary]", error);
  }

  render(): ReactNode {
    if (this.state.error) {
      return (
        <div className="p-6">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-red-700">
            Something went wrong.
          </h2>
          {isDev && (
            <pre className="mt-4 whitespace-pre-wrap rounded bg-red-50 p-4 text-xs text-red-900">
              {this.state.error.stack || this.state.error.message}
            </pre>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

```

import clsx from "clsx";
import { type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from "react";

type ButtonVariant = "default" | "primary" | "danger" | "caution" | "ghost";

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
}

export function Button({
  variant = "default",
  className,
  ...rest
}: ButtonProps): JSX.Element {
  const styles: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
    default: "bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800",
    primary: "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white",
    danger: "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white",
    caution: "bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white",
    ghost: "bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700",
  };
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={clsx(
        "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed",
        styles[variant],
        className,
      )}
      {...rest}
    />
  );
}

export function Card({
  title,
  children,
  className,
}: {
  title?: ReactNode;
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <section
      className={clsx(
        "rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm",
        className,
      )}
    >
      {title && (
        <h2 className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600">
          {title}
        </h2>
      )}
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

export function Table<T>({
  rows,
  columns,
  empty = <Empty>No rows</Empty>,
}: {
  rows: T[];
  columns: {
    key: string;
    header: ReactNode;
    render: (row: T) => ReactNode;
    align?: "left" | "right";
    sortable?: boolean;
    onSort?: () => void;
  }[];
  empty?: ReactNode;
}): JSX.Element {
  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return <div className="text-sm text-slate-500">{empty}</div>;
  }
  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
      <table className="w-full text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
            {columns.map((c) => (
              <th
                key={c.key}
                className={clsx(
                  "py-2 pr-4",
                  c.align === "right" && "text-right font-mono",
                )}
              >
                {c.sortable && c.onSort ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={c.onSort}
                    className="font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900"
                  >
                    {c.header}
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  c.header
                )}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((row, i) => (
            <tr
              key={i}
              className="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-b-0 hover:bg-slate-50"
            >
              {columns.map((c) => (
                <td
                  key={c.key}
                  className={clsx(
                    "py-2 pr-4",
                    c.align === "right" && "text-right font-mono",
                  )}
                >
                  {c.render(row)}
                </td>
              ))}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Badge({
  children,
  color = "slate",
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  color?: "slate" | "green" | "red" | "amber" | "indigo";
}): JSX.Element {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    slate: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700",
    green: "bg-green-100 text-green-800",
    red: "bg-red-100 text-red-800",
    amber: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800",
    indigo: "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800",
  };
  return (
    <span
      className={clsx(
        "inline-flex items-center rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium",
        colors[color],
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

export function Empty({ children }: { children: ReactNode }): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <div className="rounded border border-dashed border-slate-300 px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Spinner(): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <div className="inline-block h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-slate-300 border-t-slate-600" />
  );
}

export function Modal({
  open,
  onClose,
  children,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  children: ReactNode;
}): JSX.Element | null {
  if (!open) return null;
  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="max-w-lg rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-lg"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Toast({ message }: { message: string }): JSX.Element {
  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 rounded bg-slate-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white shadow-lg">
      {message}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Card, Empty, Spinner, Table, Badge } from "../ui";
import { db, type Project, type Competition, type AgentJob, type HumanDecision } from "../lib/db";

function Pill({ status }: { status: string }): JSX.Element {
  const color =
    status === "approved" || status === "succeeded"
      ? "green"
      : status === "rejected" || status === "failed"
        ? "red"
        : status === "pending" || status === "paused" || status === "running" || status === "queued"
          ? "amber"
          : "slate";
  return <Badge color={color}>{status}</Badge>;
}

export function Dashboard(): JSX.Element {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);
  const [competitions, setCompetitions] = useState<Competition[]>([]);
  const [jobs, setJobs] = useState<AgentJob[]>([]);
  const [decisions, setDecisions] = useState<HumanDecision[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [p, c, j, d] = await Promise.all([
          db.listProjects(),
          db.listCompetitions(),
          db.listInflightJobs(),
          db.listRecentDecisions(10),
        ]);
        if (!live) return;
        setProjects(p);
        setCompetitions(c);
        setJobs(j);
        setDecisions(d);
      } catch (e) {
        if (live) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
      } finally {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-500">
        <Spinner />
        Loading dashboard…
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (error) {
    return <Empty>Failed to load: {error}</Empty>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <Card title="Projects">
        {projects.length === 0 ? (
          <Empty>No projects yet.</Empty>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {projects.map((p) => (
              <div
                key={p.id}
                className="rounded border border-slate-200 p-3"
              >
                <h3 className="font-semibold">{p.name}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{p.kind ?? "general"}</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600">{p.description}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card title="Active competitions">
        <Table
          rows={competitions}
          columns={[
            { key: "slug", header: "Slug", render: (c) => c.slug },
            { key: "title", header: "Name", render: (c) => c.title ?? "—" },
            {
              key: "repo",
              header: "Repo",
              render: (c) =>
                c.repo_url ? (
                  <a
                    className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                    href={c.repo_url}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  >
                    {c.repo_url}
                  </a>
                ) : (
                  "—"
                ),
            },
            { key: "platform", header: "Platform", render: (c) => c.platform },
          ]}
          empty={<Empty>No active competitions.</Empty>}
        />
      </Card>

      <Card title="Inflight runs">
        <Table
          rows={jobs}
          columns={[
            { key: "id", header: "Job", render: (j) => j.id.slice(0, 8) },
            { key: "model", header: "Model", render: (j) => j.model ?? "—" },
            {
              key: "status",
              header: "Status",
              render: (j) => <Pill status={j.status} />,
            },
            {
              key: "started_at",
              header: "Started",
              render: (j) => j.started_at?.slice(0, 19) ?? "—",
            },
            {
              key: "turns",
              header: "Turns",
              align: "right",
              render: (j) => j.turns_used ?? 0,
            },
            {
              key: "cost",
              header: "Cost ($)",
              align: "right",
              render: (j) => (j.cost_usd ?? 0).toFixed(4),
            },
          ]}
          empty={<Empty>No inflight runs.</Empty>}
        />
      </Card>

      <Card title="Recent decisions">
        <Table
          rows={decisions}
          columns={[
            {
              key: "type",
              header: "Operation",
              render: (d) => d.decision_type,
            },
            {
              key: "status",
              header: "Status",
              render: (d) => <Pill status={d.status} />,
            },
            {
              key: "requested_by",
              header: "By",
              render: (d) => d.requested_by ?? "—",
            },
            {
              key: "created",
              header: "Requested",
              render: (d) => d.created_at.slice(0, 19),
            },
          ]}
          empty={<Empty>No decisions recorded.</Empty>}
        />
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { MemoryRouter } from "react-router-dom";
import { Dashboard } from "./Dashboard";

vi.mock("../lib/db", () => {
  return {
    db: {
      listProjects: vi.fn(async () => [
        {
          id: "p1",
          name: "demo",
          kind: "kaggle",
          description: "demo project",
          created_at: "2026-05-22T00:00:00Z",
        },
      ]),
      listCompetitions: vi.fn(async () => [
        {
          id: "c1",
          project_id: "p1",
          platform: "kaggle",
          slug: "spaceship-titanic",
          title: "Spaceship Titanic",
          repo_url: null,
          default_branch: null,
          created_at: "2026-05-22T00:00:00Z",
        },
      ]),
      listInflightJobs: vi.fn(async () => [
        {
          id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000abc",
          project_id: "p1",
          competition_id: null,
          status: "running",
          prompt: null,
          model: "sonnet",
          policy: null,
          turns_used: 3,
          cost_usd: 0.12,
          error: null,
          started_at: "2026-05-22T10:00:00Z",
          finished_at: null,
          created_at: "2026-05-22T10:00:00Z",
          otel_trace_id: null,
        },
      ]),
      listRecentDecisions: vi.fn(async () => [
        {
          id: "d1",
          project_id: "p1",
          job_id: null,
          decision_type: "kaggle_submit",
          prompt: "ok?",
          options: null,
          status: "pending",
          rationale: null,
          requested_by: "kca",
          created_at: "2026-05-22T11:00:00Z",
          decided_at: null,
        },
      ]),
    },
  };
});

describe("Dashboard", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it("renders the four sections from mock data", async () => {
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <Dashboard />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText(/Projects/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    expect(screen.getByText(/Active competitions/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Inflight runs/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Recent decisions/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    // mock data flows through
    expect(screen.getByText("demo")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("spaceship-titanic")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

```

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { Badge, Card, Empty, Spinner, Table } from "../ui";
import {
  db,
  type AgentJob,
  type AgentJobEvent,
  type AgentTelemetrySpan,
} from "../lib/db";

const EVENT_TYPES = [
  "tool_call",
  "tool_result",
  "decision_request",
  "approval_pause",
  "reviewer_reject",
  "review_verdict",
  "budget_warning",
  "error",
];

function SpanLane({
  spans,
  jobStart,
}: {
  spans: AgentTelemetrySpan[];
  jobStart: number;
}): JSX.Element {
  if (spans.length === 0) return <Empty>No spans for this job.</Empty>;
  const ends = spans.map((s) =>
    s.ended_at ? new Date(s.ended_at).getTime() : Date.now(),
  );
  const maxEnd = Math.max(...ends);
  const dur = Math.max(1, maxEnd - jobStart);
  const groups = Array.from(new Set(spans.map((s) => s.kind || s.name)));
  const width = 800;
  const rowHeight = 22;
  const padding = 4;

  return (
    <svg
      data-testid="swim-lane"
      width={width}
      height={groups.length * rowHeight + 2 * padding}
      role="img"
      aria-label="run timeline swim-lane"
      className="rounded border border-slate-200 bg-white"
    >
      {groups.map((g, i) => (
        <g key={g} transform={`translate(0, ${padding + i * rowHeight})`}>
          <text x={2} y={14} className="fill-slate-500 text-[10px]">
            {g}
          </text>
          {spans
            .filter((s) => (s.kind || s.name) === g)
            .map((s, j) => {
              const start = new Date(s.started_at).getTime();
              const end = s.ended_at
                ? new Date(s.ended_at).getTime()
                : start + 100;
              const x = 60 + ((start - jobStart) / dur) * (width - 80);
              const w = Math.max(2, ((end - start) / dur) * (width - 80));
              const fill =
                s.status === "error"
                  ? "#fca5a5"
                  : s.ended_at
                    ? "#86efac"
                    : "#fde68a";
              return (
                <g key={j}>
                  <rect
                    x={x}
                    y={2}
                    width={w}
                    height={rowHeight - 6}
                    fill={fill}
                  >
                    <title>
                      {s.name} • {s.duration_ms ?? 0}ms •{" "}
                      {JSON.stringify(s.attributes ?? {})}
                    </title>
                  </rect>
                </g>
              );
            })}
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

function EventLog({ events }: { events: AgentJobEvent[] }): JSX.Element {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<string>("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const pageSize = 25;
  const filtered = useMemo(
    () => (filter ? events.filter((e) => e.event_type === filter) : events),
    [events, filter],
  );
  const pageRows = filtered.slice(page * pageSize, (page + 1) * pageSize);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <label className="text-xs text-slate-500">Filter:</label>
        <select
          value={filter}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setFilter(e.target.value);
            setPage(0);
          }}
          className="rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-sm"
        >
          <option value="">all</option>
          {EVENT_TYPES.map((t) => (
            <option key={t} value={t}>
              {t}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          {filtered.length} events
        </span>
      </div>
      <Table
        rows={pageRows}
        columns={[
          {
            key: "ts",
            header: "ts",
            render: (e) => e.created_at.slice(11, 19),
          },
          {
            key: "type",
            header: "type",
            render: (e) => <Badge>{e.event_type}</Badge>,
          },
          {
            key: "summary",
            header: "summary",
            render: (e) => {
              const ed: any = e.event_data ?? {};
              const summary = ed.tool ?? ed.operation ?? ed.verdict ?? "";
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="text-left text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setOpen((o) => ({ ...o, [e.id]: !o[e.id] }))
                  }
                >
                  {summary || "—"}
                  {open[e.id] && (
                    <pre className="mt-1 max-w-lg overflow-x-auto rounded bg-slate-50 p-2 text-[11px]">
                      {JSON.stringify(e.event_data, null, 2)}
                    </pre>
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            },
          },
        ]}
        empty={<Empty>No events.</Empty>}
      />
      {filtered.length > pageSize && (
        <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={page === 0}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(0, p - 1))}
            className="disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            ← prev
          </button>
          <span>
            page {page + 1} / {Math.ceil(filtered.length / pageSize)}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={(page + 1) * pageSize >= filtered.length}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
            className="disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            next →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function RunTimeline(): JSX.Element {
  const { jobId } = useParams<{ jobId: string }>();
  const [job, setJob] = useState<AgentJob | null>(null);
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<AgentJobEvent[]>([]);
  const [spans, setSpans] = useState<AgentTelemetrySpan[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!jobId) return;
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [j, e, s] = await Promise.all([
          db.getJob(jobId),
          db.listJobEvents(jobId),
          db.listJobSpans(jobId),
        ]);
        if (!live) return;
        setJob(j);
        setEvents(e);
        setSpans(s);
      } finally {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [jobId]);

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;
  if (!job) {
    return (
      <Card>
        <Empty>
          Job not found.{" "}
          <Link to="/runs" className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline">
            ← back to runs
          </Link>
        </Empty>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const jobStart = job.started_at
    ? new Date(job.started_at).getTime()
    : new Date(job.created_at).getTime();

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card title="Job summary">
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm md:grid-cols-4">
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">skill</dt>
            <dd>{(job.policy as any)?.skill_name ?? "—"}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">status</dt>
            <dd>
              <Badge>{job.status}</Badge>
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">turns</dt>
            <dd>{job.turns_used ?? 0}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">cost ($)</dt>
            <dd>{(job.cost_usd ?? 0).toFixed(4)}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">started</dt>
            <dd>{job.started_at?.slice(0, 19) ?? "—"}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">ended</dt>
            <dd>{job.finished_at?.slice(0, 19) ?? "—"}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </Card>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <Card title="Spans" className="lg:col-span-2">
          <SpanLane spans={spans} jobStart={jobStart} />
        </Card>
        <Card title="Event log">
          <EventLog events={events} />
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Card, Empty, Spinner, Table, Badge } from "../ui";
import {
  db,
  type Experiment,
  type Run,
  type Submission,
} from "../lib/db";

type SortKey = "ts" | "cv" | "lb";
type SortDir = "asc" | "desc";

interface Row {
  experiment: Experiment;
  bestCv: number | null;
  lastLb: number | null;
  lastRun: Run | null;
  lastSubmission: Submission | null;
}

export function Experiments(): JSX.Element {
  const [exps, setExps] = useState<Experiment[]>([]);
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<Run[]>([]);
  const [subs, setSubs] = useState<Submission[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submittedOnly, setSubmittedOnly] = useState(false);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const pageSize = 25;
  const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState<SortKey>("ts");
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<SortDir>("desc");

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [e, s] = await Promise.all([
          db.listExperiments(200),
          db.listSubmissions(200),
        ]);
        if (!live) return;
        setExps(e);
        setSubs(s);
        // Fetch runs for each experiment (parallel, capped).
        const allRuns: Run[] = [];
        for (const exp of e.slice(0, 200)) {
          try {
            const r = await db.listRunsForExperiment(exp.id);
            allRuns.push(...r);
          } catch {
            /* ignore */
          }
        }
        if (live) setRuns(allRuns);
      } finally {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const rows = useMemo<Row[]>(() => {
    return exps.map((exp) => {
      const expRuns = runs.filter((r) => r.experiment_id === exp.id);
      const expSubs = subs.filter((s) =>
        expRuns.some((r) => r.id === s.run_id),
      );
      const cvs = expRuns
        .map((r) => (r.metrics ?? {})["cv_score"])
        .filter((v): v is number => typeof v === "number");
      const bestCv = cvs.length ? Math.max(...cvs) : null;
      const lastSub =
        expSubs.length > 0
          ? [...expSubs].sort((a, b) =>
              (b.created_at ?? "").localeCompare(a.created_at ?? ""),
            )[0]
          : null;
      const lastLb = lastSub?.public_lb_score ?? null;
      const lastRun =
        expRuns.length > 0
          ? [...expRuns].sort((a, b) =>
              (b.created_at ?? "").localeCompare(a.created_at ?? ""),
            )[0]
          : null;
      return {
        experiment: exp,
        bestCv,
        lastLb,
        lastRun,
        lastSubmission: lastSub,
      };
    });
  }, [exps, runs, subs]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let out = rows;
    if (submittedOnly) out = out.filter((r) => r.lastSubmission);
    if (statusFilter)
      out = out.filter((r) => (r.experiment.status ?? "") === statusFilter);
    return out;
  }, [rows, submittedOnly, statusFilter]);

  const sorted = useMemo(() => {
    const out = [...filtered];
    out.sort((a, b) => {
      let av: number | string = "";
      let bv: number | string = "";
      if (sortKey === "ts") {
        av = a.experiment.created_at;
        bv = b.experiment.created_at;
      } else if (sortKey === "cv") {
        av = a.bestCv ?? -Infinity;
        bv = b.bestCv ?? -Infinity;
      } else if (sortKey === "lb") {
        av = a.lastLb ?? -Infinity;
        bv = b.lastLb ?? -Infinity;
      }
      const cmp = av < bv ? -1 : av > bv ? 1 : 0;
      return sortDir === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
    });
    return out;
  }, [filtered, sortKey, sortDir]);

  const pageRows = sorted.slice(page * pageSize, (page + 1) * pageSize);

  function toggleSort(key: SortKey): void {
    if (sortKey === key) {
      setSortDir((d) => (d === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc"));
    } else {
      setSortKey(key);
      setSortDir(key === "ts" ? "desc" : "desc");
    }
    setPage(0);
  }

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;

  const arrow = (k: SortKey): string =>
    sortKey === k ? (sortDir === "asc" ? " ↑" : " ↓") : "";

  return (
    <Card title="Experiments">
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm">
        <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={submittedOnly}
            onChange={(e) => setSubmittedOnly(e.target.checked)}
          />
          submitted only
        </label>
        <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          status:
          <input
            type="text"
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="(any)"
            className="rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-xs"
          />
        </label>
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-slate-500">
          {filtered.length} experiments
        </span>
      </div>
      <Table
        rows={pageRows}
        columns={[
          {
            key: "id",
            header: "Experiment",
            render: (r) => (
              <Link
                className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                to={`/experiments/${r.experiment.id}`}
              >
                {r.experiment.id.slice(0, 8)}
              </Link>
            ),
          },
          {
            key: "hyp",
            header: "Hypothesis",
            render: (r) => r.experiment.hypothesis ?? "—",
          },
          {
            key: "ts",
            header: <>Created{arrow("ts")}</>,
            sortable: true,
            onSort: () => toggleSort("ts"),
            render: (r) => r.experiment.created_at.slice(0, 10),
          },
          {
            key: "cv",
            header: <>CV{arrow("cv")}</>,
            sortable: true,
            onSort: () => toggleSort("cv"),
            align: "right",
            render: (r) => (r.bestCv == null ? "—" : r.bestCv.toFixed(4)),
          },
          {
            key: "lb",
            header: <>LB{arrow("lb")}</>,
            sortable: true,
            onSort: () => toggleSort("lb"),
            align: "right",
            render: (r) => (r.lastLb == null ? "—" : r.lastLb.toFixed(4)),
          },
          {
            key: "status",
            header: "Status",
            render: (r) => <Badge>{r.experiment.status ?? "—"}</Badge>,
          },
          {
            key: "last",
            header: "Last run",
            render: (r) =>
              r.lastRun?.job_id ? (
                <Link
                  className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                  to={`/runs/${r.lastRun.job_id}`}
                >
                  open
                </Link>
              ) : (
                "—"
              ),
          },
        ]}
        empty={<Empty>No experiments match the filters.</Empty>}
      />
      {sorted.length > pageSize && (
        <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={page === 0}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(0, p - 1))}
          >
            ← prev
          </button>
          <span>
            page {page + 1} / {Math.ceil(sorted.length / pageSize)}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={(page + 1) * pageSize >= sorted.length}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
          >
            next →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { Card, Empty, Spinner, Table } from "../ui";
import { db, type Run } from "../lib/db";

export function RunDetail(): JSX.Element {
  const { experimentId } = useParams<{ experimentId: string }>();
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<Run[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!experimentId) return;
    db.listRunsForExperiment(experimentId)
      .then(setRuns)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [experimentId]);

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;

  return (
    <Card title={`Experiment ${experimentId?.slice(0, 8) ?? ""}`}>
      <Table
        rows={runs.flatMap((r) =>
          Object.entries(r.metrics ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => ({
            runId: r.id,
            ts: r.created_at,
            key: k,
            value: v,
            jobId: r.job_id,
            artifactPaths: r.artifact_paths,
          })),
        )}
        columns={[
          { key: "ts", header: "ts", render: (m) => m.ts.slice(0, 19) },
          { key: "metric", header: "Metric", render: (m) => m.key },
          {
            key: "val",
            header: "Value",
            align: "right",
            render: (m) =>
              typeof m.value === "number" ? m.value.toFixed(4) : String(m.value),
          },
          {
            key: "run",
            header: "Job",
            render: (m) =>
              m.jobId ? (
                <Link
                  className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                  to={`/runs/${m.jobId}`}
                >
                  {m.jobId.slice(0, 8)}
                </Link>
              ) : (
                "—"
              ),
          },
        ]}
        empty={<Empty>No metrics recorded.</Empty>}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}

````typescript
/**
 * Tiny safe Markdown renderer.
 *
 * Intentionally no remote dependency. Supports headings, paragraphs,
 * inline code, fenced code blocks, lists, and links. Everything else falls
 * through as plain text. Hostile inputs (`<script>`, `javascript:` URLs,
 * inline event handlers) are stripped — we never inject raw user HTML.
 */

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

function sanitiseHref(href: string): string {
  const trimmed = href.trim();
  if (/^javascript:/i.test(trimmed)) return "#";
  if (/^data:/i.test(trimmed)) return "#";
  return trimmed;
}

export function renderMarkdown(src: string): string {
  if (!src) return "";

  const lines = src.split(/\r?\n/);
  let html = "";
  let inCode = false;
  let inList = false;

  for (const raw of lines) {
    if (raw.startsWith("```")) {
      if (inCode) {
        html += "</code></pre>";
        inCode = false;
      } else {
        if (inList) {
          html += "</ul>";
          inList = false;
        }
        html += "<pre><code>";
        inCode = true;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (inCode) {
      html += escapeHtml(raw) + "\n";
      continue;
    }

    if (raw.startsWith("# ")) {
      if (inList) {
        html += "</ul>";
        inList = false;
      }
      html += `<h1>${inline(escapeHtml(raw.slice(2)))}</h1>`;
      continue;
    }
    if (raw.startsWith("## ")) {
      if (inList) {
        html += "</ul>";
        inList = false;
      }
      html += `<h2>${inline(escapeHtml(raw.slice(3)))}</h2>`;
      continue;
    }
    if (raw.startsWith("- ") || raw.startsWith("* ")) {
      if (!inList) {
        html += "<ul>";
        inList = true;
      }
      html += `<li>${inline(escapeHtml(raw.slice(2)))}</li>`;
      continue;
    }
    if (raw.trim() === "") {
      if (inList) {
        html += "</ul>";
        inList = false;
      }
      continue;
    }

    html += `<p>${inline(escapeHtml(raw))}</p>`;
  }

  if (inCode) html += "</code></pre>";
  if (inList) html += "</ul>";
  return html;
}

function inline(s: string): string {
  // Strip any HTML tags that slipped through escapeHtml (defensive: should
  // be impossible since we already escaped them).
  s = s.replace(/(?:<[^>]+>)/g, "");
  // Inline code
  s = s.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, "<code>$1</code>");
  // Links: [text](url) — sanitise href.
  s = s.replace(
    /\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g,
    (_match, text: string, url: string) => {
      const href = sanitiseHref(url);
      return `<a href="${href}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${text}</a>`;
    },
  );
  // Image: ![alt](url) → load-image placeholder, never auto-fetched.
  s = s.replace(
    /!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g,
    (_match, alt: string, url: string) => {
      const safe = sanitiseHref(url);
      return `<span class="rounded bg-slate-100 px-1 text-xs text-slate-600">[image: ${alt || safe}]</span>`;
    },
  );
  return s;
}

```typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Badge, Card, Empty, Spinner } from "../ui";
import {
  db,
  type ResearchCitation,
  type ResearchItem,
} from "../lib/db";
import { renderMarkdown } from "../lib/markdown";

function trustColor(trust: string): "green" | "amber" | "red" {
  if (trust === "high") return "green";
  if (trust === "medium") return "amber";
  return "red";
}

export function Research(): JSX.Element {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ResearchItem[]>([]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [citations, setCitations] = useState<ResearchCitation[]>([]);
  const [showSource, setShowSource] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    db.listResearchItems(50)
      .then((r) => {
        if (!live) return;
        setItems(r);
        if (r.length > 0) setSelected(r[0].id);
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selected) return;
    db.listCitationsForRun(selected).then(setCitations).catch(() => setCitations([]));
  }, [selected]);

  const active = useMemo(
    () => items.find((i) => i.id === selected) ?? null,
    [items, selected],
  );

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;
  if (items.length === 0)
    return (
      <Card title="Research">
        <Empty>No research items yet.</Empty>
      </Card>
    );

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <Card title="Items" className="lg:col-span-1">
        <ul className="space-y-2">
          {items.map((it) => (
            <li key={it.id}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelected(it.id)}
                className={`block w-full rounded p-2 text-left text-sm hover:bg-slate-50 ${
                  selected === it.id ? "bg-indigo-50" : ""
                }`}
              >
                <div className="font-medium">{it.title ?? it.url}</div>
                <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  <Badge color={trustColor(it.trust)}>{it.trust}</Badge>
                  <a
                    href={it.url}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="truncate hover:underline"
                    onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  >
                    {it.url}
                  </a>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-400">
                  fetched {it.fetched_at?.slice(0, 19) ?? "—"}
                </div>
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Card>
      <Card title={active?.title ?? "Item"} className="lg:col-span-2">
        {active ? (
          <div>
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              <Badge color={trustColor(active.trust)}>{active.trust}</Badge>
              <a
                href={active.url}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
              >
                source ↗
              </a>
            </div>
            <article
              className="prose prose-sm max-w-none"
              dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
                __html: renderMarkdown(active.summary ?? ""),
              }}
            />
            <h3 className="mt-6 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
              Citations
            </h3>
            {citations.length === 0 ? (
              <Empty>No citations for this run.</Empty>
            ) : (
              <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1 text-xs text-slate-700">
                {citations.map((c) => (
                  <li key={c.id} className="rounded border border-slate-100 p-2">
                    {c.quote && <p className="italic">"{c.quote}"</p>}
                    {c.job_id && (
                      <Link
                        to={`/runs/${c.job_id}`}
                        className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                      >
                        job {c.job_id.slice(0, 8)}
                      </Link>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
            <details
              className="mt-6"
              open={showSource}
              onToggle={(e) => setShowSource((e.target as HTMLDetailsElement).open)}
            >
              <summary className="cursor-pointer text-xs text-slate-500">
                raw source
              </summary>
              <pre className="mt-2 overflow-x-auto rounded bg-slate-50 p-2 text-[10px] text-slate-700">
                {active.url}
              </pre>
            &lt;/details>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Empty>Select an item.</Empty>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { renderMarkdown } from "./markdown";

describe("renderMarkdown sanitiser", () => {
  it("escapes <script> tags", () => {
    const out = renderMarkdown("# hi\n\n<script>alert(1)</script>\n");
    expect(out).not.toContain("<script>");
    expect(out).toContain("&lt;script&gt;");
  });

  it("strips javascript: hrefs from links", () => {
    const out = renderMarkdown("[click](javascript:alert(1))");
    expect(out).toContain('href="#"');
    expect(out).not.toContain("javascript:");
  });

  it("adds rel=noopener noreferrer to links", () => {
    const out = renderMarkdown("[ok](https://example.com)");
    expect(out).toContain('rel="noopener noreferrer"');
    expect(out).toContain('target="_blank"');
  });

  it("placeholders images instead of fetching them", () => {
    const out = renderMarkdown("![alt](https://remote.example.com/x.png)");
    expect(out).not.toContain("<img");
    expect(out).toContain("[image:");
  });
});

"""kca decisions: list, approve, and deny human approval requests."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json

from _types import EXIT_OK, EXIT_RUNTIME, SideEffect


def _emit(ok: bool, payload: dict, exit_code: int = EXIT_OK) -> int:
    print(json.dumps({"ok": ok, **payload}, ensure_ascii=False))
    return exit_code


def _load_db():
    """Import db module; raise ImportError or DBNotConfigured if unavailable."""
    import db as _db

    return _db


def cmd_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    try:
        _db = _load_db()
        job_id = getattr(args, "job_id", None)
        rows = _db.list_pending_decisions(job_id=job_id)
        decisions = [
            {
                "id": str(r.get("id", "")),
                "decision_type": r.get("decision_type", ""),
                "status": r.get("status", ""),
                "prompt": r.get("prompt", ""),
                "created_at": str(r.get("created_at", "")),
                "job_id": str(r.get("job_id", "")) if r.get("job_id") else None,
            }
            for r in rows
        ]
        payload: dict = {
            "decisions": decisions,
            "side_effect": SideEffect.READ_ONLY.value,
        }
        if getattr(args, "include_reviews", False):
            review_rows = _db.list_reviews(job_id=job_id, limit=50)
            payload["reviews"] = [
                {
                    "id": str(r.get("id", "")),
                    "job_id": str(r.get("job_id", "")) if r.get("job_id") else None,
                    "verdict": r.get("verdict", ""),
                    "target_op": r.get("target_op", ""),
                    "reviewer_model": r.get("reviewer_model", ""),
                    "rationale": (r.get("rationale") or "")[:200],
                    "created_at": str(r.get("created_at", "")),
                }
                for r in review_rows
            ]
        return _emit(True, payload)
    except Exception as exc:
        # Exit 0 with ok=false for graceful DB-unavailable degradation.
        return _emit(False, {"error": str(exc), "decisions": []})
```

```python
"""FastAPI action service for the M8 Decision Gate UI.

The browser never holds a service-role Supabase key. It posts to
``/decision/<id>/approve|reject|ask-improve``; this service re-uses the
existing ``tools/kca/decisions.py`` functions and ``tools/kca/db.py`` writes
so the M7 permission policy stays authoritative.

Auth: a shared token in ``KCA_DECISION_API_TOKEN``. Requests must include the
matching ``X-Decision-Api-Token`` header. Multi-user auth lands in M9+.

Testing: pass a ``decisions_module`` override (e.g. via dependency injection)
to swap in a mocked DB layer.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hmac
import os
from typing import Callable, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, Header, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


TOKEN_ENV = "KCA_DECISION_API_TOKEN"


class ApproveBody(BaseModel):
    reason: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)


class RejectBody(BaseModel):
    reason: str = Field(..., min_length=8, max_length=2000)


class AskImproveBody(BaseModel):
    feedback: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=4000)
    metric_target: Optional[str] = None


def _check_token(provided: Optional[str]) -> None:
    expected = os.environ.get(TOKEN_ENV, "")
    if not expected:
        # If the server has no token configured, accept any (local dev only).
        return
    if not provided or not hmac.compare_digest(provided, expected):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="invalid token")


def make_app(
    decisions_module: Optional[object] = None,
    audit_logger: Optional[Callable] = None,
) -> FastAPI:
    """Construct the FastAPI app.

    ``decisions_module`` exposes ``get_decision``, ``resolve_decision``, and
    ``append_job_event``. Tests pass a fake module to avoid touching Supabase.
    """
    app = FastAPI(title="kca decision_api", version="0.1.0")

    def _resolve_db():
        if decisions_module is not None:
            return decisions_module
        import sys
        from pathlib import Path

        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "tools" / "kca"))
        import db as _db  # type: ignore

        return _db

    def _audit(*, decision: str, decision_id: str, reason: Optional[str]) -> None:
        if audit_logger is not None:
            audit_logger(
                decision=decision, decision_id=decision_id, reason=reason or ""
            )
            return
        try:
            from tools.kca.agent.audit import log_policy_decision  # type: ignore

            log_policy_decision(
                tool="decision_api",
                operation=f"decision_{decision}",
                decision="allow",
                policy_profile="default",
                args={"decision_id": decision_id, "reason_len": len(reason or "")},
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _get_pending(decision_id: str):
        _db = _resolve_db()
        row = _db.get_decision(decision_id)
        if not row:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="not found")
        if row.get("status") != "pending":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=409,
                detail=f"decision is {row.get('status')}, not pending",
            )
        return row

    @app.post("/decision/{decision_id}/approve")
    def approve(
        decision_id: str,
        body: ApproveBody,
        x_decision_api_token: Optional[str] = Header(default=None),
    ) -> dict:
        _check_token(x_decision_api_token)
        row = _get_pending(decision_id)
        _db = _resolve_db()
        _db.resolve_decision(decision_id, "approved", notes=body.reason)
        _audit(decision="approve", decision_id=decision_id, reason=body.reason)
        return {"ok": True, "decision_id": decision_id, "status": "approved", "job_id": row.get("job_id")}

    @app.post("/decision/{decision_id}/reject")
    def reject(
        decision_id: str,
        body: RejectBody,
        x_decision_api_token: Optional[str] = Header(default=None),
    ) -> dict:
        _check_token(x_decision_api_token)
        row = _get_pending(decision_id)
        _db = _resolve_db()
        _db.resolve_decision(decision_id, "rejected", notes=body.reason)
        _audit(decision="reject", decision_id=decision_id, reason=body.reason)
        return {"ok": True, "decision_id": decision_id, "status": "rejected", "job_id": row.get("job_id")}

    @app.post("/decision/{decision_id}/ask-improve")
    def ask_improve(
        decision_id: str,
        body: AskImproveBody,
        x_decision_api_token: Optional[str] = Header(default=None),
    ) -> dict:
        _check_token(x_decision_api_token)
        row = _get_pending(decision_id)
        _db = _resolve_db()
        # Append a feedback event so the worker can pick it up on resume.
        if row.get("job_id"):
            _db.append_job_event(
                job_id=str(row["job_id"]),
                event_type="feedback",
                event_data={
                    "feedback": body.feedback,
                    "metric_target": body.metric_target,
                    "source": "decision_api.ask_improve",
                },
            )
        _db.resolve_decision(decision_id, "needs_improvement", notes=body.feedback)
        _audit(decision="ask_improve", decision_id=decision_id, reason=body.feedback)
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "decision_id": decision_id,
            "status": "needs_improvement",
            "job_id": row.get("job_id"),
        }

    return app


app = make_app()

```

"""decision_api tests with a mocked DB layer (no real Supabase calls)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import types
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from services.decision_api.app import make_app


class FakeDB:
    """In-memory stand-in for tools/kca/db. Captures calls so tests can assert."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.decisions: dict = {
            "abc": {
                "id": "abc",
                "status": "pending",
                "job_id": "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111",
                "decision_type": "kaggle_submit",
            },
            "open2": {
                "id": "open2",
                "status": "pending",
                "job_id": None,
                "decision_type": "external_fetch",
            },
        }
        self.events: list[dict] = []

    def get_decision(self, decision_id: str) -> dict | None:
        return self.decisions.get(decision_id)

    def resolve_decision(self, decision_id: str, resolution: str, notes=None) -> None:
        self.decisions[decision_id]["status"] = resolution
        self.decisions[decision_id]["notes"] = notes

    def append_job_event(
        self,
        job_id: str,
        event_type: str,
        event_data=None,
        **_kwargs,
    ) -> int:
        evt = {"job_id": job_id, "event_type": event_type, "event_data": event_data}
        self.events.append(evt)
        return len(self.events)


@pytest.fixture
def client() -> TestClient:
    fake = FakeDB()
    app = make_app(decisions_module=fake, audit_logger=lambda **_: None)
    c = TestClient(app)
    c.app = app  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    c.fake = fake  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return c


def test_decision_api_approve_idempotent(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r1 = client.post("/decision/abc/approve", json={"reason": "ok"})
    assert r1.status_code == 200, r1.text
    assert r1.json()["status"] == "approved"

    r2 = client.post("/decision/abc/approve", json={"reason": "ok"})
    assert r2.status_code == 409, r2.text


def test_decision_api_reject_minlength(client: TestClient) -> None:
    short = client.post("/decision/abc/reject", json={"reason": "short"})  # 5
    assert short.status_code == 422

    ok = client.post(
        "/decision/abc/reject", json={"reason": "explanation"}
    )
    assert ok.status_code == 200
    assert ok.json()["status"] == "rejected"


def test_decision_api_ask_improve_appends_event(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r = client.post(
        "/decision/abc/ask-improve",
        json={"feedback": "please retry with seed=42"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    fake = client.fake  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    feedback_events = [e for e in fake.events if e["event_type"] == "feedback"]
    assert feedback_events, "expected a feedback event"
    assert feedback_events[0]["event_data"]["feedback"].startswith("please retry")


def test_decision_api_404_for_unknown(client: TestClient) -> None:
    r = client.post("/decision/no_such/approve", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 404


def test_decision_api_token_required(monkeypatch) -> None:
    fake = FakeDB()
    monkeypatch.setenv("KCA_DECISION_API_TOKEN", "secret")
    app = make_app(decisions_module=fake, audit_logger=lambda **_: None)
    c = TestClient(app)
    r = c.post("/decision/abc/approve", json={"reason": "x"})
    assert r.status_code == 401
    r2 = c.post(
        "/decision/abc/approve",
        json={"reason": "x"},
        headers={"X-Decision-Api-Token": "secret"},
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 200

```

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Badge, Card, Empty, Spinner, Table } from "../ui";
import { db, type HumanDecision } from "../lib/db";

export function ApprovalInbox(): JSX.Element {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<HumanDecision[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    db.listPendingDecisions()
      .then(setRows)
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;

  return (
    <Card title="Approval Inbox">
      <Table
        rows={rows}
        columns={[
          {
            key: "operation",
            header: "Operation",
            render: (d) => (
              <Link
                className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                to={`/approvals/${d.id}`}
              >
                {d.decision_type}
              </Link>
            ),
          },
          {
            key: "run",
            header: "Job",
            render: (d) =>
              d.job_id ? (
                <Link
                  to={`/runs/${d.job_id}`}
                  className="text-indigo-700 hover:underline"
                >
                  {d.job_id.slice(0, 8)}
                </Link>
              ) : (
                "—"
              ),
          },
          {
            key: "requested",
            header: "Requested",
            render: (d) => d.created_at.slice(0, 19),
          },
          {
            key: "status",
            header: "Status",
            render: (d) => <Badge color="amber">{d.status}</Badge>,
          },
        ]}
        empty={<Empty>No pending decisions — inbox is clear.</Empty>}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}

  "supabase_migrate",
  "git_push",
]);

async function callApi(
  decisionId: string,
  action: "approve" | "reject" | "ask-improve",
  body: object,
): Promise<Response> {
  const token = readApiToken();
  return fetch(`/api/decision/${decisionId}/${action}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(token ? { "X-Decision-Api-Token": token } : {}),
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
}

function readApiToken(): string | null {
  // Same-origin cookie set out-of-band by `kca ui login`.
  const m = document.cookie.match(/kca_api_token=([^;]+)/);
  return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
}

interface MetaState {
  decision: HumanDecision | null;
  job: AgentJob | null;
  reviews: AgentReview[];
  audit: AgentToolAudit[];
  artifactPreview: { kind: "text" | "binary" | "none"; body: string };
}

export function DecisionGate(): JSX.Element {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const nav = useNavigate();
  const [state, setState] = useState<MetaState | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<"approve" | "reject" | "ask" | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const decision = await db.getDecision(id);
        const job = decision?.job_id ? await db.getJob(decision.job_id) : null;
        const reviews = decision?.job_id
          ? await db.listReviewsForJob(decision.job_id)
          : [];
        const audit = decision?.job_id
          ? await db.listToolAudit(decision.job_id, 20)
          : [];
        if (!live) return;
        setState({
          decision,
          job,
          reviews,
          audit,
          artifactPreview: { kind: "none", body: "" },
        });
      } catch (e) {
        if (live) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
      } finally {
        if (live) setLoading(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [id]);

  const isSubmission = useMemo(() => {
    if (!state?.decision) return false;
    return SUBMISSION_OPERATIONS.has(state.decision.decision_type);
  }, [state]);

  const rejectDisabled = reason.trim().length < 8;
  const feedbackDisabled = feedback.trim().length < 1;

  async function doApprove(): Promise<void> {
    if (!id) return;
    setBusy("approve");
    try {
      const r = await callApi(id, "approve", { reason: reason || undefined });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}: ${await r.text()}`);
      nav("/approvals");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  async function doReject(): Promise<void> {
    if (!id || rejectDisabled) return;
    setBusy("reject");
    try {
      const r = await callApi(id, "reject", { reason });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}: ${await r.text()}`);
      nav("/approvals");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  async function doAskImprove(): Promise<void> {
    if (!id || feedbackDisabled) return;
    setBusy("ask");
    try {
      const r = await callApi(id, "ask-improve", { feedback });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}: ${await r.text()}`);
      nav("/approvals");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <Spinner />;
  if (!state || !state.decision) {
    return (
      <Card>
        <Empty>Decision not found.</Empty>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  const { decision, job, reviews, audit } = state;
  const policyProfile =
    (job?.policy as { policy_profile?: string } | null)?.policy_profile ??
    "default";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card title={`Decision ${decision.id.slice(0, 8)}`}>
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-sm md:grid-cols-3">
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">operation</dt>
            <dd>{decision.decision_type}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">status</dt>
            <dd>
              <Badge color="amber">{decision.status}</Badge>
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">policy profile</dt>
            <dd>{policyProfile}</dd>
          </div>
          {job && (
            <>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">cost ($)</dt>
                <dd>{(job.cost_usd ?? 0).toFixed(4)}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">turns</dt>
                <dd>{job.turns_used ?? 0}</dd>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </dl>
      </Card>

      {reviews.length > 0 && (
        <Card title="Reviewer">
          {reviews.map((r) => (
            <div key={r.id} className="rounded border border-slate-100 p-2 text-sm">
              <Badge
                color={
                  r.verdict === "approve"
                    ? "green"
                    : r.verdict === "reject"
                      ? "red"
                      : "slate"
                }
              >
                {r.verdict}
              </Badge>
              <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                {r.reviewer_model}
              </span>
              {r.rationale && (
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-700">{r.rationale}</p>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card title="Recent tool audit (last 20)">
        <Table
          rows={audit}
          columns={[
            { key: "ts", header: "ts", render: (a) => a.ts.slice(11, 19) },
            { key: "tool", header: "Tool", render: (a) => a.tool_name },
            {
              key: "decision",
              header: "Decision",
              render: (a) => (
                <Badge
                  color={
                    a.decision === "allow"
                      ? "green"
                      : a.decision === "deny"
                        ? "red"
                        : "amber"
                  }
                >
                  {a.decision}
                </Badge>
              ),
            },
          ]}
          empty={<Empty>No audit rows yet.</Empty>}
        />
      </Card>

      <Card title="Actions">
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-3 rounded bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        <label className="text-xs text-slate-500">
          Reason (required for reject, min 8 chars)
        </label>
        <input
          className="mt-1 w-full rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-sm"
          value={reason}
          onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="why are you taking this action?"
        />

        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            data-testid="approve-btn"
            variant={isSubmission ? "danger" : "caution"}
            onClick={doApprove}
            disabled={busy !== null}
          >
            {busy === "approve" ? <Spinner /> : "Approve"}
          </Button>
          <Button
            data-testid="reject-btn"
            variant="default"
            onClick={doReject}
            disabled={busy !== null || rejectDisabled}
          >
            {busy === "reject" ? <Spinner /> : "Reject"}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-6 border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
          <label className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            Feedback to the agent (ask-improve)
          </label>
          <textarea
            className="mt-1 w-full rounded border border-slate-200 px-2 py-1 text-sm"
            rows={3}
            value={feedback}
            onChange={(e) => setFeedback(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="describe what to change for the next iteration"
          />
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            className="mt-2"
            onClick={doAskImprove}
            disabled={busy !== null || feedbackDisabled}
            data-testid="ask-improve-btn"
          >
            {busy === "ask" ? <Spinner /> : "Ask agent to improve"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

```
